coverage_semantics: All four exact inventory entries have a hash-bound portable C++ model. File I/O and XDK virtual/physical allocation are represented by a complete byte input; valid XPR2 parsing, record relocation semantics, texture physical-data fixups, case-insensitive lookup, size, and object-data access are preserved. Additional bounds checks reject malformed archives without changing valid-input behavior.

entries.evidence: validates XPR2, reads metadata and physical payloads separately, walks 16-byte records, relocates name/object offsets, and fixes both physical pointers in TX records
walks every 16-byte record and performs case-insensitive full-name comparison against its relocated name field
returns zero on lookup failure or the matched record's offset-8 size
returns null on lookup failure or metadata base plus 12 plus the matched record's offset-4 object offset

settingsapp_binding.basis: The loader recognizes the same XPR2/TX structure and the three accessor bodies are relocation-normalized matches documented by SettingsApp ownership evidence.
